title: Analyzer-Assisted Evaluation Result
description: Schema for individual evaluation results in the four-condition analyzer-assisted experiment. Extends the consumer-v1 result format with condition identity, artifact provenance, failure classification, and context telemetry.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this result record.

experiment_id.description: Experiment identifier from the experiment manifest.

condition_id.description: Which experiment condition produced this result.

condition_available.description: Whether the condition's artifacts were available for this evaluation. False means the condition was skipped.

question_id.description: Question identifier from the corpus (e.g. INV-001, FACT-003).

question_category.description: Question category derived from the corpus tier.

model.description: Model identifier used for this evaluation (e.g. claude-opus-4-6).

seed.description: Random seed used for the evaluation run, if any.

runner_version.description: Version of the evaluation runner that produced this result.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this evaluation was executed.

architecture_context_sha.description: Git SHA of the architecture-context repository used.

index_generation_sha.description: Git SHA or generation identifier for INDEX.md, if applicable.

query_binary_version.description: Version of arch-query binary used, if applicable.

corpus_version.description: Version of the benchmark corpus used.

experiment_manifest_version.description: Version of the experiment manifest used.

success.description: Whether the agent session completed without infrastructure failure.

source_citations.description: Source files and lines cited in the response.

error.description: Error message if the session failed.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock time for this evaluation in seconds.

num_turns.description: Number of agent turns in the session.

tool_calls.description: Count of each tool invoked during the session.

files_read.description: List of files read during the session.

telemetry.description: Token, cost, and timing telemetry. All values must be non-negative when present.

context_fetches.description: Number of context fetch operations (reads + queries).

useful_reads.description: Reads that contributed to the final answer.

navigation_reads.description: Reads used for navigation/discovery that did not directly answer the question.

queries_issued.description: Number of arch-query queries issued (arch-query and combined conditions only).

missing_context_detected.description: Whether the agent detected missing information in the architecture docs.

stale_context_detected.description: Whether the agent detected stale/outdated information.

unsupported_inference_detected.description: Whether the agent made an inference beyond what the context supports.

context_metrics.description: Context fetch and read quality metrics. Populated when OTel instrumentation is available; null otherwise.

failure_classifications.description: Zero or more failure classifications for this result. Empty array means no failures detected.
